description: Na₂CeO₃ is High Pressure (4-7GPa) Tellurium-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are seven inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two CeO₆ octahedra, edges with three CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with five NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-11°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.51 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.68 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.52 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four CeO₆ octahedra, edges with three CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with five NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-11°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.57 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two CeO₆ octahedra, edges with three CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with four NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-11°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.52 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.62 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four CeO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with four NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-15°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.54 Å. There are four inequivalent Ce sites. In the first Ce site, Ce is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted CeO₆ octahedra that share corners with five NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with four NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-15°. There are a spread of Ce-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.38 Å. In the second Ce site, Ce is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ce-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.47 Å. In the third Ce site, Ce is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted CeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with six NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-11°. There are a spread of Ce-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.30 Å. In the fourth Ce site, Ce is bonded to six O atoms to form CeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one CeO₆ octahedra, and edges with six NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 11°. There are a spread of Ce-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.30 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ce atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Ce atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and three Ce atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₃Ce₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-15°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ce atoms to form ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra that share corners with four ONa₃Ce₃ octahedra and edges with eight ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-9°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ce atoms to form ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra that share corners with three ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra and edges with eight ONa₃Ce₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-12°. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ce atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-12°. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ce atoms to form distorted ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra that share corners with three ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra and edges with nine ONa₃Ce₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-9°. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Ce atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ce atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₄Ce₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-15°.
